description: Circular references under each host-configured cycle profile (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §7a). Pins the host-surfaced OUTCOME class per profile; iterated numeric values are Excel/engine-anchored (OxCalc W048 + OxXlPlay/OxReplay) and are NOT asserted here.

cases.name: self-cycle is blocked under the default non-iterative profile
cases.note: Default ≡ Excel with iterative calc off: the region is rejected, members are cycle_blocked, no new values publish, prior values remain visible.

cases.name: two-node SCC is blocked under the default non-iterative profile
cases.note: A=B+10 and B=A/2 form an SCC; both members block under the default profile.

cases.name: self-cycle iterates and publishes under the Excel-match profile
cases.note: With iterative calc on, Excel does not raise a circular-reference error; =SelfRef+1 reaches the iteration bound and publishes a terminal value. The exact value is Excel-anchored (OxXlPlay/OxReplay), not asserted here.

cases.name: convergent SCC publishes under the deterministic profile
cases.note: A=B+10, B=A/2 has the fixed point A=20, B=10; Jacobi iteration converges within the bound and the region publishes atomically. The value is engine-anchored, not asserted here.

cases.name: convergent self-cycle publishes under the deterministic profile
cases.note: =Converge/2 + 5 has the fixed point 10; converges under deterministic Jacobi iteration.

cases.name: divergent self-cycle is rejected under the deterministic profile
cases.note: =SelfRef+1 grows without bound; the deterministic profile rejects a non-converging region — contrast cyc-excel-match-self-published, where Excel publishes the bound value.

cases.name: non-numeric cycle is rejected before iteration under the deterministic profile
cases.note: =TextCycle & "x" has a non-numeric prior; the deterministic profile rejects before iterating.
